Vendors

Vendors are suppliers who provide raw materials, ingredients, or products to the partners (sellers) on the Homecuties platform. Unlike partners who sell directly to customers, vendors supply the inventory that partners then list and sell. Each vendor can have multiple users assigned with different roles who manage purchase orders, supply deliveries, and vendor relationships.
